reasoning: Each dimension has lower bound 2.35 m, so the minimum volume is 2.35^3 = 12.977875 cubic meters, rounding to 13.0 cubic meters. This agrees with the earlier answer, the submitted option d graded Correct, and Math Academy's worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence:
So, the smallest possible volume of the tank is

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =2.35\,\text{m}\times 2.35\,\text{m}\times 2.35\,\text{m} \\  & =12.977\,875\,{\text{m}}^{3} \\  & ≈13.0\,{\text{m}}^{3},\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest tenth of a cubic meter.
